description: StEER - Hurricane Barry (2019): Event Briefing is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Tracy Kijewski-Correa, University of Notre Dame (nd.edu). This Event Briefing summarizes the characteristics and impacts of Hurricane Barry (2019), which made landfall in Louisiana on July 13, 2019. A high level summary of the structural impacts are provided relative to the estimated hazard intensities, including wind, storm surge and heavy rainfall. Key lessons related to the observed impacts are provided. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-fzhn-2g10. Keywords: StEER, Event Briefing, Hurricane, Barry, Structural. Published 2019-07-17. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
